description: This is an HTML source file implementing the front-end interface for a database visualizer application, including UI layout, styles, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections and updating the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the selected database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data with support for wide content and expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with toggles for expanded view.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full or truncated content, including object prettification.
